notTested: A screen-reader walk-through by a person (VoiceOver or NVDA): only automated checks have run.
Speaking into a real microphone: the voice session is issued live, but no one has dictated into it from a browser yet.
Testing with disabled people: none has been done.
Hands-free mode with a real camera and a real face: the face tracker loads and runs in an automated browser with a fake camera (no face), but no person has pointed, calibrated or winked with it.
Hands-free voice commands spoken aloud: the command parser is unit-tested in all four languages, but no one has spoken them into a browser.
Hindi, Indonesian and Portuguese wording read by a native speaker: every translation is machine-written.
features: A 'Display and help' panel in every header: larger text, more contrast, reduced motion, simpler words.
Skip link to the main content on every page; focus moves to the page heading on navigation.
Touch targets at least 44 px; every icon-only button has a name.
Status and errors are announced (role=status, role=alert); the AI work rail is a live region.
Nothing depends on colour alone: pass and fail carry words and icons.
Push-to-talk on the owner's Ask and the member's assistant (gpt-live-1 session, words by gpt-4o-transcribe); typing always works.
Scrolling tables and code boxes can be reached and scrolled with the keyboard.

handsfree.what: Hands-free mode (header button or Alt+H): point with the head or the eyes through the webcam, click by looking for a moment, by saying "click" or with a wink; voice commands in English, Hindi, Bahasa Indonesia and Brazilian Portuguese. The camera picture is processed on the device by MediaPipe Face Landmarker and never uploaded.
published: Webcam eye tracking is accurate to about 100 to 200 px. That figure is Peek's own published one (the deixis-main README), not a Kept measurement.
At that accuracy a 30 px row is too small to hit reliably, so hands-free mode raises every control to at least 44 px and spaces lists out.
Kept switches to head pointing when eye pointing measures worse than 120 px on the check dots.
handsfree.measuredNote: No person has calibrated Kept's hands-free mode on a real camera yet, so there is no published accuracy. Each device shows its own figure, in pixels, after its calibration (9 dots fitted, 4 check dots measured).
inCode: Which control is outlined: votes weighted by distance and jitter, fading within a fraction of a second, hysteresis, saccade reset, drift correction from clicks (web/src/handsfree/snap.ts)
When a dwell or wink clicks, and the blink freeze
"Stop" in all four languages, Esc, and looking away for 2 seconds
Reading a control's state (turned off, already selected) before pressing it
The confirm card: any pay, refund, cancel, delete, send, approve, decline or dispute waits for a spoken or clicked "yes" with the amount and recipient shown; anything else cancels
The 10-step cap on a spoken request
Handing back to the mouse or touch the moment it moves
byModel: A spoken request that is not a fixed command goes to the member's assistant on the page, which uses the shop's MCP tools under a signed mandate (the same as typing it).
credits: MediaPipe Face Landmarker (Google, Apache 2.0), served from Kept itself
Approach described in the READMEs of Peek (deixis-main) and movo (head pointing). Neither repository has a licence file, so no code was copied; Kept's version is written from scratch.
